component.name: Axis IP Tool
component.summary: Find and set up Axis network cameras

description.p: Finds Axis devices on the local network (Bonjour/mDNS and SSDP) and performs the basic setup known from the AXIS IP Utility:

ul.li: Create the first administrator on devices in factory default state
Configure IPv4 (DHCP or static), hostname and DNS
Set time zone, NTP servers or synchronise the clock
Configure many devices at once: sequential IP addresses, numbered host names or a CSV plan
Open the web interface, restart devices or reset them to factory defaults

description.p: Findet Axis-Geräte im lokalen Netz (Bonjour/mDNS und SSDP) und erledigt die Grundeinrichtung wie die AXIS IP Utility.
Not an official product of Axis Communications AB.
Configure many devices at once, login status with password check, factory reset, host name column.
First release: discovery, initial password, network, time/NTP, snapshot preview.
